video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a Latina woman about 31 years old with tan skin and long dark hair in a low ponytail, wearing a plain white t-shirt and light jeans — sits alone, sitting on a wooden stool in a modern home kitchen with white cabinets, a marble island, pendant lights and a few plants, daylight from a window, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. Handheld-steady phone on a tripod, the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, serious and caring, like warning a friend, with small natural head movements; her hands stay clasped near her knees with small gestures.
